status: Exploratory retrospective extension; 2025-2026 outcomes were already inspected in the starter project. This is not a fresh confirmatory holdout.
hypothesis: Trailing absolute returns, daily range and volume surprises contain incremental information about next-observation absolute returns beyond a trailing-20 baseline.
validation: Year immediately preceding each test year; all earlier observations used for initial training, then refit through validation year.
models: ReLU neural network width=16 epochs=20 Adam lr=.001 seed=42
convex ensemble weights selected on validation only at increments of .25
primary_metric: MAE; equal weight per stock-day observation
uncertainty: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap of daily mean MAE differences; 10-session blocks, 2000 draws; sensitivity at 5 and 20 sessions. Exploratory intervals; not adjusted for multiple comparisons or research selection.
ablation: Ridge with trailing absolute-return features only versus full-feature ridge, refit per fold.
